D23_gate7_disposition.additional_structural_reason: the statistic is R-dependent: 1 - p^R - (1-p)^R increases in R, so the same physical dataset would fail harder simply for being sampled more thoroughly
D23_gate7_disposition.what_must_still_be_guaranteed: that the observations are honest and reproducible, which the replacement gates below cover
D23_gate7_disposition.why_a_disagreement_rate_gate_is_inapprop: under Target V4 a mixed replica outcome was an anticipated nuisance to be bounded. Under a probabilistic target it is the SIGNAL: an event with k = 1 or 2 out of 3 is precisely an observation that p is interior. Capping how often that occurs would cap how much information the dataset carries about the decision boundary.
